I am an old woman now, 85 years, and this small shamba of mine is all I have. The soil here in Mwanza is tired and I cannot afford fertilizer from the shop — those prices are too much for someone like me. I will plant my own seeds that I saved, mix the crops together as I have always done, and put some manure from the goats around the plants. My grandchildren will help me with the heavy work like clearing and weeding, because these old hands cannot do everything anymore.
